description: This file defines the FavoritesController class, an ASP.NET Core MVC controller responsible for handling HTTP requests related to favoriting or unfavoriting articles. It includes methods to add or remove an article from favorites, utilizing MediatR to send commands.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core MVC controller that manages favoriting and unfavoriting articles, interfacing with MediatR to process commands.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST requests to favorite an article identified by its slug, sending an Add.Command via MediatR.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to unfavorite an article based on its slug, sending a Delete.Command via MediatR.
